tools.name: bank-payments_uk-modulus-check
tools.description: Check whether a UK sort code and account number pair can be valid using Vocalink modulus weights (valacdos/scsubtab) and exceptions 1–14. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/bank-payments/uk-modulus-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: bank-payments_sepa-creditor-id-validate
tools.description: Parse a SEPA Direct Debit Creditor Identifier and recompute ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 check digits (business code excluded). Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/bank-payments/sepa-creditor-id-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: bank-payments_iban-from-bban
tools.description: Compute ISO 13616 check digits for a country code and domestic BBAN, then validate the resulting IBAN structure. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/bank-payments/iban-from-bban. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: bank-payments_uetr-validate
tools.description: Validate an ISO 20022 UETR as a UUID version 4, or generate one or more UETRs with crypto.randomUUID(). Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/bank-payments/uetr-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: bank-payments_postal-address-check
tools.description: Classify an ISO 20022 PostalAddress as structured, hybrid or unstructured and check Swift CBPR+ town/country/AdrLine rules. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/bank-payments/postal-address-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: bank-payments_nacha-file-build
tools.description: Generate a 94-character NACHA ACH file (PPD/CCD/WEB/TEL) with batch hashes, totals and blocking-factor padding from JSON entries. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/bank-payments/nacha-file-build. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: bank-payments_nacha-file-validate
tools.description: Validate NACHA record order, lengths, ABA checksums, batch/file hashes and totals, reporting every structural error by line. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/bank-payments/nacha-file-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: bank-payments_camt053-parse
tools.description: Parse an ISO 20022 bank-to-customer statement or report into normalised JSON with balance reconciliation checks. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/bank-payments/camt053-parse. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "bank-payments" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bank-payments_uk-modulus-check, bank-payments_sepa-creditor-id-validate, bank-payments_iban-from-bban, bank-payments_postal-address-check · Private data: bank-payments_nacha-file-build, bank-payments_nacha-file-validate · Public sink: bank-payments_uk-modulus-check, bank-payments_sepa-creditor-id-validate, bank-payments_iban-from-bban, bank-payments_uetr-validate, bank-payments_postal-address-check, bank-payments_nacha-file-build, bank-payments_nacha-file-validate, bank-payments_camt053-parse · Destructive: bank-payments_uk-modulus-check, bank-payments_sepa-creditor-id-validate, bank-payments_iban-from-bban, bank-payments_uetr-validate, bank-payments_postal-address-check, bank-payments_nacha-file-build, bank-payments_nacha-file-validate, bank-payments_camt053-parse.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
